statement: A deterministic production-seam lease chronology witness names the exact active node rejected by ControlPlaneSnapshotOwner and correlates its canonical nodes-row heartbeat, owner-minted lease expiry, row-write HLC, and per-key CDC observation in the MovieLens schema-admission report; replayed publication failure, write-owner delay, CDC delay, and inactive-node controls are classified without changing readiness, repair, or admission outcomes.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The change may add cache-owned observation provenance, snapshot diagnostics, deterministic replay, and report retention only; it must not change ready-lease duration, heartbeat cadence, readiness, repair scheduling, admission, retry, timeout, placement, membership, quorum, or remove-safety behavior.

The existing ControlPlaneSnapshotOwner stale-watermark scan remains the only freshness adjudicator and selects the witness for the exact row whose existing readiness evaluation fails; no second detector, demo exception, or alternate freshness rule may be introduced.

CDC observation time is cache-owned per table key and bound to the accepted row origin HLC; ignored, causally older, backfill-only, partial, authoritative, or hydration changes cannot advance or impersonate CDC provenance, and table-wide apply time is not a valid substitute.

Owner-write chronology must derive from the existing cache-only row HLC and its physical component; do not add durable nodes columns, invent a commit timestamp, or claim pre-dispatch producer attribution that the canonical owner currently rebases away.

The deterministic discriminator must exercise the real heartbeat intent, canonical node-state publication owner, CDC event/cache ingress, snapshot owner, and MovieLens schema-admission report path; stubs may observe outer effects but cannot replace the binding owner seams.

Missing heartbeat publication, delayed canonical write, delayed CDC observation, expired or missing lease, causally older CDC replay, authoritative cache replacement, unexpired lease, and inactive terminal-node controls must remain independently distinguishable and cannot make a stale snapshot fresh.
The structured witness may be retained in snapshots and reports, but time-varying witness values must not be embedded in reason codes, error strings, transition keys, or metric identities.

Do not rerun the unchanged MovieLens scenario. A single changed-source production run is allowed only after three deterministic scenario passes, red-on-revert evidence, exact independent verification, clean-container and source-fingerprint preflight, and a cool host; its purpose is attribution rather than weakening or relabeling the sealed gate.
